ip.label: Mill heater IP address
ip.help: IP address of the Mill heater on the local network.

apiTimeout.label: HTTP timeout
apiTimeout.help: Maximum wait time for a response from the local Mill API.
apiTimeout.validatorErrorText: Timeout is too short. It must be at least 1 second.

pollInterval1.label: Polling interval 1
pollInterval1.help: Interval for the normal (fast) polling of the Mill heater in seconds. Must be at least HTTP timeout (${data.apiTimeout}) + 1 second.
pollInterval1.validatorErrorText: Polling interval 1 is too short. It must be at least ${data.apiTimeout + 1} seconds.

pollInterval2.label: Polling interval 2
pollInterval2.help: Interval for the second, longer-term (slow) polling in seconds. Must be at least polling interval 1 (${data.pollInterval1}) + HTTP timeout (${data.apiTimeout}).
pollInterval2.validatorErrorText: Polling interval 2 is too short. It must be at least ${data.pollInterval1 + data.apiTimeout} seconds.
